_comment: Scope: hub-only audit target. filter_paths drops deps/tests/scripts/mocks and the dormant out-of-scope cross-chain contracts (see dev-docs/audit/SCOPE.md §4). Excluded detectors are noise on a pinned-solc OZ-upgradeable codebase (naming/solc-version/pragma); upgradeable-proxy false positives (e.g. constructor/initializer) are handled by OZ's @custom:oz-upgrades annotations already present in source. Triage real findings before ratcheting CI fail-on to medium.
